title: Crispy Yeast Hake Tacos
description: A Mexican-inspired recipe featuring crispy fried hake, served with a side of warm tortillas and a sprinkle of yeast-infused spices.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix yeast with 1/4 cup of warm milk. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
2. In a large bowl, mix flour, mexican spices, and yeast mixture. Gradually add milk and mix until a smooth batter forms.
3. Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
4. Dip each hake fillet into the yeast batter, then coat with flour, and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side.
5. Drain the fried hake on paper towels.
6. Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
7. Assemble the tacos by placing fried hake on a tortilla, topping with onions and a sprinkle of cumin.
